component.name: OpenBGI
component.summary: Plays the games of the BGI/Ethornell engine

description.p: OpenBGI is an open-source reimplementation of Ethornell's Buriko General Interpreter, the engine of many visual novels. It plays the games from their own files: a folder, a zip archive or a disc image, none of which it changes.

Started without a game it shows a launcher: the games of the folders it was told about, each with a picture, to start with a click. The same program holds the tools to take a game's archives, scenarios and programs apart and to put them together again.
